# CERES

> CERES (Calibrated Early-warning and Risk Estimation System) is an open, automated famine early-warning system operated by Northflow Technologies AS. It issues calibrated 90-day probability forecasts of acute food insecurity (IPC Phase 3+, Phase 4+, and Famine) for 43 high-risk countries, refreshed every Monday at 06:00 UTC.

## What CERES is

- Operator: Northflow Technologies AS (https://northflow.no). CERES runs as HGE Adapter #5 on the Northflow inference engine.
- Coverage: 43 high-risk countries.
- Horizon: 90-day probability forecasts.
- Cadence: weekly, issued every Monday at 06:00 UTC.
- Outputs: P(IPC Phase 3+ 90d), P(IPC Phase 4+ 90d), P(Famine 90d), a composite stress score, an alert tier, and a 90% sensitivity interval per region.

## Data inputs

CERES draws on six core public data streams:

1. CHIRPS rainfall
2. MODIS NDVI vegetation
3. UCDP GED conflict events
4. IPC classifications
5. WFP VAM market data
6. FAO GIEWS

FEWS NET is used as a supplementary cross-check, not a core input. UNHCR is not an active input.

## Model and validation

- Method: calibrated logistic regression over the six public data streams, with input-perturbation sensitivity intervals (n=2,000 draws per prediction).
- Initialisation accuracy: AUC 0.84 on a held-out split of 87 IPC transition records across 31 countries (2011-2023).
- Forward validation: every prediction is timestamped, publicly recorded, and graded against published IPC outcomes at the T+90 horizon. Predictions have been issued since the 28 Feb 2026 launch; the first T+90 grading windows opened June 2026 and the first graded outcomes are expected Aug-Oct 2026.

## Important distinction

CERES does not declare famine. Only the IPC Global Platform declares Famine (IPC Phase 5). A CERES Tier-1 alert indicates a high probability of a region reaching IPC Phase 3+; it is an early-warning signal, not an official classification.

CERES is the Northflow famine early-warning system. It is not the NASA CERES radiation instrument and not the dwarf planet Ceres.

## Licence
